notes: Major release that converts the package to ESM-only and raises the minimum Node.js version. CommonJS projects using require('node-fetch') break and must switch to dynamic import or stay on 2.x.

evidence.text: node-fetch v3.0.0 is an ESM-only package. You cannot import it with require() anymore; use ESM import syntax or a dynamic import() from CommonJS. The minimum supported Node.js version is now 12.20. Consult the changelog for the full list of breaking changes before upgrading.
